audit.summary: The ramified prime construction's t1=t3 dyadic justification fails in an admissible number field. A general character-based replacement is proved. The displayed singular-series density lacks normalization (Minor), with a separate supported affine-prime route. Selmer/definability branches supported; common-prime degeneracy resolved by permitted large exponent. No main theorem counterexample.
limitations: P1 — Equal squareclasses do not eliminate the dyadic unit obstruction — Counterevidence: Only equal quadratic characters are needed. Full squareclass equality unnecessarily restricts first/third residues; general replacement constructed.

P2 — The singular-series local count lacks its residue-volume normalization — Counterevidence: Independent Kai affine-prime-pattern theorem applies after parameterizing W as a coset; neither localdensity display nor subgroup wording refutesProposition3.1.
Limitations: External theorem proofs not wholly re-proved
Limitations: Kai analytic estimates and full local/global duality machinery remain dependencies

proposition.claim:
Taking t1=t3 in t1*x²+2r gamma^(n ell)*t2*y²=t3*z² removes local obstruction at all dyadic conductor primes.

Displayed q/(q-1)^3 limit of unnormalized unit-pair counts modulo p^n gives local singular-series factor.
